description: This Java class defines a fragment for the language pack setup wizard in the AnySoftKeyboard app. It manages UI interactions for downloading language packs, checking if the step is completed, and handling user actions like skipping or proceeding to download language packs.

classes.name: WizardLanguagePackFragment
classes.description: A fragment managing the language pack setup step in the wizard, including UI interactions and state management.

methods.name: isStepCompleted
methods.description: Checks if the current language pack setup step is completed based on shared preferences and available language packs.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, setting the skipped state and creating the search controller.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up click listeners for UI elements to handle user actions like opening the store or skipping the step.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up resources, dismissing the search controller.

methods.name: refreshFragmentUi
methods.description: Updates the UI based on the current state, such as enabling/disabling icons.

methods.name: getPageLayoutId
methods.description: Returns the layout resource ID for this fragment's UI.
